narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>End it in zero, so it works for five.
<bookmark mark='flip'/>Read backwards, that zero becomes the first digit of the code.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A code that starts with zero is no longer six digits, so zero cannot go last.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows end it in 0; the dials flip backwards and the 0 lands in front; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, divide your code by fifteen, and the reversed code by six.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Both divisions should leave nothing over, as they do here.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; 200025 ÷ 15 = 13335 and 520002 ÷ 6 = 86667 appear as the check

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says end it in zero so it works for five. Read backwards, zero becomes the first digit and the code is no longer six digits.
